answer: Churn is counted in river, and velvet publishes the ratio each epoch. At most 21% of an operator's declared identities may be replaced in one epoch, which means rotating keys to dodge slashing does not reset the record. An adversary who burns aliases faster than the churn cap simply runs out of replacements, and the replacements it does make inherit the relic history. A 82 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
